id: Bài đăng diễn đàn về ba mươi ngày chạy bộ
kind: 30 days of running: what I learned
L: (1) Minh: I started jogging thirty days ago, and I'm still surprised I haven't quit.
At first, I could only run for five minutes before I felt out of breath.
Now I can run for half an hour without stopping, which feels amazing.
My secret? I run with a friend, so I can't skip a day.
(2) Thu: Congrats, Minh! I tried running last year, but I gave up after two weeks.
My knees hurt because I didn't warm up properly.
Any tips for beginners like me?
(3) Minh: Always warm up for five minutes and buy proper shoes.
Don't compare yourself with others, and rest when your body tells you to!
